translations.web: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
translations.bsb: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the very commandment you have heard from the beginning, that you must walk in love.
translations.kjv: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
